name: Salmon River (Riggins)
blurb: Lower Salmon country. Day floats past Riggins, or the multi-day Hammer Creek to Heller Bar desert canyon.

sections.notes: Town-to-town. Warm water in summer, jet boats possible. Time Zone Rapid is the named drop.
The Lower Salmon. Typically 3–4 days. Snowhole is the big rapid. BLM camps, rattlesnakes, and a serious shuttle.
